content_data.project_description: Implementation of an integrated compliance management system to automate regulatory reporting across US, Canada, and Mexico operations, reducing manual processing time and ensuring adherence to evolving trade regulations.
content_data.timeline: 18 months with Phase 1 (months 1-6) focusing on system selection and vendor onboarding, Phase 2 (months 7-12) on implementation and integration, and Phase 3 (months 13-18) on testing and rollout
content_data.project_lead: Priya Deshmukh, VP of Operations and Compliance
objectives: Minimize compliance-related penalties and operational delays
Create scalable framework for future regulatory expansion
Achieve 100% on-time regulatory filing across all jurisdictions
deliverables: Comprehensive training program for 150+ operational staff
Updated standard operating procedures and compliance playbooks
Automated reporting workflows for customs, transportation, and trade documentation
content_data.risk_assessment: Medium-high risk due to complex multi-jurisdictional regulatory requirements and dependency on third-party system integrations. Mitigation strategies include phased rollout approach, dedicated legal counsel oversight, and contingency budget allocation for regulatory changes.
